claims.text: The rider's claim is that the trip was driven on a longer route than needed. The governing distance is the GPS trace polyline, not the rounded trip-record copy: gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 4.05 km against a booked optimal of 3.2 km, an excess of 0.85 km. That excess is 26.56% of optimal, which clears the 20% limb of POL-RD-01, and it clears the 0.8 km absolute limb as well (0.85 > 0.80). Both establishment tests pass, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own trace.

The trace is clean for policy purposes: 37 fixes at a 10 s sample interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps and a max gap of 0 s, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are not met and no independent corroboration is required. The rider's burden under POL-RD-08(a) is also discharged — trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02821 and the trace runs 08:31:41 to 08:37:41, matching the trip record's started_at and ended_at.

The driver's only explanation on file is 'Followed the app.' That is a general assertion, not a clause invocation: it points to no traffic_advisory, no chat_log instruction, no amended endpoint and no pooled itinerary. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded, so the burden does not shift back to the rider and no exculpatory clause under POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 or POL-RD-12 is available to the driver.

The traffic-advisory artifact for this trip is MISSING — no advisory covers the Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 corridor in this window, weight_multiplier 0.0. Under POL-RD-13 the driver's implicit external-cause excuse cannot be tested against any advisory, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight; the deviation therefore stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route. The absence is itself citable, and the ruling must record that no advisory was on file.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 on a METERED fare. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 7.0) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = (3.80 + 2.40 + 1.96) + 0.80 = 8.96. Charged_total is 9.28, so the refund is 9.28 - 8.96 = 0.32, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 0.35. The surge multiplier is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and is 1.0, so it changes nothing.

The refund is not de minimis: 0.32 before rounding exceeds the SGD 0.50 floor? It does not — the pre-rounding refund of 0.32 is below the SGD 0.50 de_minimis_refund, and the fare_breakdown's own derived block records below_de_minimis as true. On the policy as written, POL-RD-02 therefore directs NO_ACTION on the distance-and-time refund, and I concede that point rather than stretch it.

No billing-integrity correction is available to the rider either: the fare_breakdown carries zero ERP gantry lines (erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp 0.0) and no airport surcharge, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport, so POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to refund. The rider's contested amount of $1.00 is not recoverable on this record.

The driver's profile does not support a repeat-deviation finding: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 314 completed_trips_90d, so neither limb of the POL-RD-06 pattern test (3 or more flags, or a ratio of 0.05 or more) is met. No FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral follow. I note that prior_deviation_flags is 1, but that is a lifetime counter and POL-RD-06 and POL-GEN-01 forbid substituting it for the trailing-90-day figure.

The rider's profile likewise does not trigger the POL-RD-08 corroboration uplift: deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the 4-or-more threshold is not met and the claim needs no corroboration beyond the trace. The rider's no_show_disputes_30d of 1 is a NO_SHOW counter and is irrelevant to this route-deviation dispute.

The driver's own trace shows a continuous, gap-free run at 34-46 kph with no stop and no circling, and the chat log is empty (0 messages), so there is no rider-requested detour, no amended pickup or dropoff (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null), and no pooled itinerary (vehicle_type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL). Every exculpatory route in POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 is closed on the record, which is why the measured excess stands undiminished.

Because 0.32 is below the SGD 0.50 de_minimis_refund constant, POL-RD-02 directs NO_ACTION rather than a partial refund, and both advocates' own calculations on this point are accepted. There is no ERP, toll or surcharge line to correct under POL-RD-09 (0 ERP gantries, 0.00 tolls, 0.0 airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport), and no fare line lacks a counterpart, so no billing-integrity referral arises; the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. The charge stands exactly as it is. Confidence rests on the trip record, GPS trace and fare breakdown, all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so it is not capped below the 0.70 floor and no escalation under POL-RD-10 applies.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides agree on the facts, and the arithmetic decides this case.

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. Measured on the GPS trace — the figure POL-RD-01 makes governing over the rounded trip-record copy — the trip ran 4.05 km against a booked optimal of 3.2 km: an excess of 0.85 km, or 26.56% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (26.56% > 20%, and 0.85 km > 0.8 km), so the deviation stands on this trip's own trace. It does NOT reach the materiality gate (0.85 km is below 8.0 km and 26.56% is below 50%), so this is an established but non-material deviation: the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not engaged here and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows.

NO CORROBORATION IS NEEDED AND NONE OF THE DRIVER'S EXCUSES APPLY. The trace is clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 37 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0 s — so limbs (a) to (c) are not met and the rider's POL-RD-08(a) burden is discharged (trip record, trace and fare breakdown all carry TRP-02821 with matching start/end times). Exculpation fails on every route: the chat log is empty (0 messages), so POL-RD-04 is unavailable and no waypoint is corroborated; pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not close or move anything; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's statement 'Followed the app' is a general assertion citing no artifact and no clause; it discharges nothing under POL-RD-08 and does not reduce the measured excess.

THE REMEDY IS DE MINIMIS, SO NO MONEY MOVES. Under POL-RD-02 on this METERED fare: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 3.2 + 0.28 × 7.0) × 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 8.96. The surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (the only artifact that carries it). Charged_total is 9.28, and refund = 9.28 − 8.96 = 0.32 before rounding. That is below the SGD 0.50 de_minimis_refund, and POL-RD-02 directs NO_ACTION on a refund below that floor — the fare_breakdown's own derived block records below_de_minimis as true. So the rider's contested amount is not recovered, not because the route was optimal but because the overcharge on the metered distance-and-time lines is only 0.32. If you believe the trace itself is wrong, either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

POL-RD-09 GIVES NOTHING EITHER WAY. The fare_breakdown carries zero ERP gantry lines (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00) and no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), so there is no phantom line or off-route pass-through to correct. On the driver's side, the distance charged (4.0 km) is only 0.05 km short of the trace (4.05 km), far below the 1.0 km threshold in POL-RD-04, so no DRIVER_COMPENSATION arises.

THE MISSING ADVISORY. The only traffic_advisory, EV-ADVIS-02821-01, is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 and carries no fact. Claims from both sides that cited it were discarded at the citation check for not disclosing its MISSING_ARTIFACT impairment, and I have rested nothing on it. The driver asserted no external traffic cause in any event, so the deviation stands at the measured figure.

PROFILES. The driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 314 completed_trips_90d, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and no FULL_REFUND uplift or referral follows; the rider's deviation_claims_60d is 0, so no extra independent-source requirement applies. The near-synonym lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags was mentioned only to say it may not be substituted, and it has not been used. Neither profile bears on this trip's finding.

Confidence is 0.90, capped at 1.0 by the deciding artifacts, all of which are COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0. The present state stands: fare_breakdown.payment_status remains CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd remains 0.00. The monetary effect is nil, and so is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold. No clause produces a referral here.
